words.gloss: takes the place of / has the status of

literal: Even falsehood is of the status of truth, if it yields fault-free goodness.
translation: Even falsehood has the nature of truth, if it produces pure, faultless good.
modern: குற்றம் இல்லாத நன்மையை விளைவிக்கும் என்றால், பொய் சொல்லுவதும் வாய்மையின் தன்மையைப் பெறும்.
explanation: This couplet presents a profound ethical perspective on truth. It states that even an untruth (பொய்மையும்) can be elevated to the status of truth (வாய்மை இடத்த) under one condition: if it results in completely faultless good (புரைதீர்ந்த நன்மை பயக்கும் எனின்). The key words 'புரைதீர்ந்த நன்மை' emphasize that the outcome must be entirely free from harm or bad intentions. Thus, the moral value of speech is judged not just by literal accuracy, but by the benevolent impact it has on others.
